column1: # OWL Functional syntax files that OBO projects edit by hand or with ROBOT:
# tools/corpus/fetch-ofn.sh downloads them into test/corpus-ofn/ (not tracked),
# and `ofn_real_files` in src/ofn/tests.rs parses them with OFN_REAL=1. Each URL
# names a commit, so the files do not change; the sha256 is checked after the
# download and for files already present. Columns, tab-separated:
#   name     where it lands under test/corpus-ofn/
#   url      https only, at a commit
